definitions.gloss: mixed blood; mixed race; mixed heritage
definitions.explanation: Having parents of different racial or ethnic backgrounds. Can refer to the state of being mixed-race or to a person of mixed heritage.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{日本人|にほんじん}とフランス{人|じん}の{混血|こんけつ}だ。
examples.english: She is of mixed Japanese and French heritage.

examples.japanese: {混血|こんけつ}であることをアイデンティティの{一部|いちぶ}として{誇|ほこ}りに{思|おも}っている。
examples.english: She takes pride in her mixed heritage as part of her identity.

notes: This term is considered somewhat dated and clinical. In modern Japanese, ハーフ is widely used for people with one Japanese and one non-Japanese parent, though some consider that term reductive as well. {混血|こんけつ}{児|じ} (child of mixed race) appeared frequently in post-war writing. In biology, {混血|こんけつ} can also refer to crossbreeding of animals. Related: ハーフ (half — person of mixed Japanese and foreign parentage), ダブル (double — preferred alternative to ハーフ by some), {混血|こんけつ}{児|じ} (mixed-race child — dated).
